brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Montenegro's EU accession bid faces a race against time to resolve bilateral issues with Croatia. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR MONTENEGRO
Montenegro's net energy import dependency of 33% underscores the importance of foreign investment, such as from Azerbaijan, for energy security. [4][E3]

KEY RISKS
Montenegro's link to 7 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a risk to its international financial and diplomatic standing. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the blocked vote on the Montenegrin Speaker's removal remains unresolved. [1]
Whether Montenegro can resolve bilateral issues with Croatia in time to advance its EU accession bid is an open question. [5]
